=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:1467-1492 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: detect_stalls does not pass max_recoveries_by_phase into resolve_stall_recovery_action, so the per-phase effective cap is ignored on that path.
  WHY: The call path still falls back to the global cap, undermining the intended per-phase recovery budget.
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:1601-1611 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: detect_stalls accepts max_recoveries but has no max_recoveries_by_phase parameter.
  WHY: Callers cannot supply per-phase caps directly to this function.
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:1678-1717 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: detect_stalls compares phase_attempts_count against the global max_recoveries instead of the per-phase effective cap.
  WHY: ai:done stalls can be skipped after 5 attempts even when the configured per-phase cap is 99, prematurely closing the PR.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3406-3443 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: Integration-conflict backoff uses a lifetime dispatch_count without resetting it between clean conflict episodes.
  WHY: A later independent conflict can inherit the previous episode’s higher cooldown multiplier and wait hours before resolver dispatch.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3482-3492 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The integration-conflict exponential backoff uses a dispatch_count value that is not reset when a conflict episode ends cleanly.
  WHY: A new conflict on the same integration branch can start with a stale high multiplier and an unnecessarily long cooldown.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5630-5650 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Reissue paths reset stall_recovery_count but do not reset phase_attempts, so replacement issues inherit exhausted counters.
  WHY: The reissued issue reuses the same wave entry, and the first stall can immediately hit skip instead of running the recovery ladder.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:7380-7410 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The standalone reissue path resets stall_recovery_count but not phase_attempts.
  WHY: The fresh issue can inherit exhausted phase_attempts from the prior issue and skip recovery on its first stall.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8871 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The deferred issue-creation reissue path resets stall_recovery_count but does not reset phase_attempts.
  WHY: The replacement issue reuses the same wave entry, so exhausted phase counters carry over into the new issue.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10314-10341 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The review-blocked judge reissue path resets stall_recovery_count but does not reset phase_attempts.
  WHY: The new issue inherits the old issue’s exhausted phase counters and can be skipped immediately on its first stall.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5905-5935 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The judge cache key hashes only issue_num, head_sha, phase, and last_conclusion.
  WHY: Mutable judge inputs such as comments, PR state, mergeability, and prior recovery actions can change while the cache key stays the same, replaying stale decisions.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:6054-6092 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Forced escalation writes escalate_human but does not update the cache entry.
  WHY: The next poll tick can hit the same stale cache key and immediately force escalation again instead of recording the forced decision.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: _list_integration_conflict_files fetches unnecessary history because the git fetch omits --depth=1.
  WHY: On deep or divergent repos, every poll tick can waste bandwidth and time fetching full history for the conflict probe.
- tests/test_detect_editor_changes_lost.py:274-280 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: There is an extra blank line between two top-level test functions.
  WHY: This is cosmetic only and has no runtime impact.
